title: Collection Gaps and Want-List Progress
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), vinyl plays (`vinyl:play`), LEGO sets (`lego:set`), trading-card prices (`tradingcard:price`).
app: Collection catalogues and price APIs — Discogs (vinyl), BrickLink (LEGO), trading-card and coin/stamp price feeds, and personal inventory databases with NFC-tagged scans — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=collection:item
| stats sum(eval(if(status="owned",1,0))) as owned, count as total by series
| eval pct=round(100*owned/total,1), remaining=total-owned
| sort pct
description: Tracks how close each series or set in your collection is to complete and how many items remain on the want list.
value: A per-series completion bar makes the chase visible and keeps you focused on finishing sets rather than scattering purchases.
implementation: Ingest owned-versus-target counts into `index=personal`; review completion per series.
visualization: Bar chart of completion percentage by collection series.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how close each of your collections is to complete and what is still on your wish list.
